big_nukes.guide.given: The guide is in your inventory.
big_nukes.guide.1:
Big Nukes

How to make a nuclear bomb, set it off and live through it.

2 Uranium
3 Centrifuge
4 Assembly
5 Bombs
6 Fuse
7 Keypad
8 Remote
9 Radiation
10 Commands
big_nukes.guide.2:
Uranium

Uranium ore lies below y=16, in stone and deepslate. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better: it drops raw uranium.
big_nukes.guide.3:
Centrifuge

Raw uranium on top, fuel (coal, wood, lava) in the side slot. Every 20 s it makes one enriched uranium. Hoppers feed and empty it.

Craft: iron, glass, redstone and a furnace.
big_nukes.guide.4:
Assembly table

Put the parts anywhere in its grid and press Assemble.

Charge: 1 enriched uranium, 4 TNT.
Casing: 4 iron blocks, 4 redstone.
Bombs: see their tooltips.
big_nukes.guide.5:
Bombs

Demolition charge: radius 16, no radiation.
Tactical warhead: radius 50, weak radiation.
Atomic bomb: radius 250, a zone that stays.

A blast sets off the bombs its wave reaches.
big_nukes.guide.6:
Fuse

A bomb needs a detonator: place the bomb and right-click it with one.

Light the fuse with flint and steel: you have 4 s to run.

The demolition charge takes only a fuse.
big_nukes.guide.7:
Keypad

Right-click the bomb with an empty hand. The first code you enter (3 to 8 digits) becomes its code. The right code sets it off in 5 s. Three wrong codes lock it for 30 s.
big_nukes.guide.8:
Remote

Put a receiver in the bomb, then right-click the bomb with a remote to link them. Go as far as you like, aim at the sky and right-click: it goes off.
big_nukes.guide.9:
Radiation

Big blasts leave a zone. Your dose builds there: weakness, sickness, death. A Geiger counter reads it. The hazmat suit keeps 95% out; anti-rad takes 300 rad off.
big_nukes.guide.10:
Commands

Stand 400 blocks or more from an atomic bomb.

/bignukes blast <radius> [x y z]
/bignukes maxpower [16|50|250|1024]
/bignukes guide: this book
